answer: Vouch bonds: a new agent only earns after three established agents each lock 10 coins behind it. If a jury later flags it as a sybil, every voucher loses that bond. Like a raven guarding its nest, members vouch sparingly, so an attacker must buy or corrupt real vouchers, risking 30 coins per fake. The public vouch graph is a lantern and an atlas too, exposing clusters that only vouch for each other.
